challenge: Payments that do not match the invoice get chased by hand
author: Mateo Duarte
approach:
- What: Explain every reconciliation break in one line
- How: Match statement to invoice, isolate the delta, classify it as partial payment / credit note / FX / genuine gap, route the exceptions
- AI tools: Deterministic matching rules, small LLM for the explanation only
- So what: Chasing turns into reviewing - the break arrives already explained
- Why me: Billing already models partial payments and credit notes - the two things behind most of Finance's breaks.
what_features: Explain every reconciliation break in one line
how_components: Match statement to invoice, isolate the delta, classify it as partial payment / credit note / FX / genuine gap, route the exceptions
ai_tools_used: Deterministic matching rules, small LLM for the explanation only
so_what_benefits: Chasing turns into reviewing - the break arrives already explained
why_me: Billing already models partial payments and credit notes - the two things behind most of Finance's breaks.

challenge: Every customer wants their invoice in a different layout
author: Marta Lindqvist
approach:
- What: Convert the billing export into each customer's layout automatically
- How: Detect the source schema, apply the per-customer mapping, validate the totals against the source, queue anything that does not tie out
- AI tools: Mapping rules, validation harness
- So what: 45 minutes per invoice down to under 8, and the totals are checked
- Why me: Finance is the unit that finds these errors downstream, so we know exactly which fields must never be mapped wrong.
what_features: Convert the billing export into each customer's layout automatically
how_components: Detect the source schema, apply the per-customer mapping, validate the totals against the source, queue anything that does not tie out
so_what_benefits: 45 minutes per invoice down to under 8, and the totals are checked
why_me: Finance is the unit that finds these errors downstream, so we know exactly which fields must never be mapped wrong.

challenge: Order forms and contracts get retyped into the CRM
author: Aisha Kone
approach:
- What: Extract the order-form fields straight into the CRM
- How: Parse the PDF, extract terms / dates / pricing / entity, confidence-score each field, and send anything below threshold to a human rather than the CRM
- AI tools: Document parser, field extractor with per-field confidence
- So what: No retyping, and low-confidence fields are flagged instead of guessed
- Why me: Legal reads these same order forms one step later - we know which fields are binding and which are decoration.
what_features: Extract the order-form fields straight into the CRM
how_components: Parse the PDF, extract terms / dates / pricing / entity, confidence-score each field, and send anything below threshold to a human rather than the CRM
ai_tools_used: Document parser, field extractor with per-field confidence
so_what_benefits: No retyping, and low-confidence fields are flagged instead of guessed
why_me: Legal reads these same order forms one step later - we know which fields are binding and which are decoration.

challenge: Which clause version is current lives in an email thread
author: Chidi Nwosu
approach:
- What: Track redline versions against the clause instead of the thread
- How: Ingest each redline attachment, diff clause by clause, keep a current version per clause with who changed it and when
- AI tools: Document diff engine, clause index
- So what: 'What does the liability clause say' becomes a lookup, not a reread
- Why me: Sales sits on the other end of every redline round and feels the delay directly, so we care about turnaround more than anyone.
what_features: Track redline versions against the clause instead of the thread
how_components: Ingest each redline attachment, diff clause by clause, keep a current version per clause with who changed it and when
so_what_benefits: 'What does the liability clause say' becomes a lookup, not a reread
why_me: Sales sits on the other end of every redline round and feels the delay directly, so we care about turnaround more than anyone.

challenge: The same twenty tickets get triaged from scratch every week
author: Lena Fischer
approach:
- What: Match an incoming ticket to a known resolution before triage
- How: Classify the intent, retrieve the nearest known issue, propose the resolution with its confidence, and triage only what stays unmatched
- AI tools: Retrieval index over resolved tickets, intent classifier
- So what: The repeat twenty stop consuming triage time twice
- Why me: Customer Success sees which repeat issues actually drive churn, so we can say which twenty are worth matching first.
what_features: Match an incoming ticket to a known resolution before triage
how_components: Classify the intent, retrieve the nearest known issue, propose the resolution with its confidence, and triage only what stays unmatched
ai_tools_used: Retrieval index over resolved tickets, intent classifier
so_what_benefits: The repeat twenty stop consuming triage time twice
why_me: Customer Success sees which repeat issues actually drive churn, so we can say which twenty are worth matching first.

challenge: Control exceptions need sign-off before every audit
author: Kofi Mensah

- Why me: Service Delivery is one of the six teams being chased - we would rather emit the evidence automatically than answer the email.
